raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: lightning
  version: "2.6.5"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/lightning-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 16a30310ed69afde3748491feb5d13508908effd70390d2bfc203dc0812a4b4a

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - packaging
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
    - wheel
  run:
    - fsspec <2028.0,>=2022.5.0
    - lightning-utilities <2.0,>=0.10.0
    - packaging <27.0,>=23.0
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pytorch <4.0,>=2.1.0
    - pytorch-lightning
    - pyyaml <8.0,>5.4
    - torchmetrics <3.0,>0.7.0
    - tqdm <6.0,>=4.57.0
    - typing_extensions <6.0,>4.5.0
tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - lightning
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning
  summary: The Deep Learning framework to train, deploy, and ship AI products Lightning fast.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Borda
    - weiji14
